# Contextual carrier with a fixed nominal result slot

Owned `<K> Map<K,String> make(List<K>,Config)` corpus. A complete invariant input
carrier binds the sole method formal. A known nongeneric configuration and fixed
nominal result tail retain their exact types. The provider records both incoming
references and reads a wide configuration field before its original mutation,
throw and result-cast operations. Source and frozen SDK-provider routes each run
216 fresh JVM cases twice, compile all generated source and check full metadata,
method/helper inventories, generic reflection, exact failures and partial state.
Six same-Code Signature controls and eight independent wrong programs must fail.
All sources and observers are owned; no private material is included.
